main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.p: principes exorta, ineundæ sanciendæque sint pacificationes; & quanta cura ad earum formulas sit attendendum. 275
main_text.head: Casus LIX.
main_text.p: Quomodo in Republ. comminisci liceat & expediat vectigalia, quæ cum minimo & propemodum nullo subditorum onere sunt conjuncta, & tamen Reipub. utilissima futura. 290
main_text.head: Casus LX.
main_text.p: Quomodo imprimis probanda sint & facilè admittantur ea vectigalia, quæ non tam titulo necessitatis publicæ, quam emendandorum, qui corrupti sunt morum imponuntur. 296

page.notes: Blue ink underlining marks the entries in the printed index; the lines are reproduced here as plain text. Page numbers 275, 290 and 296 are the index references printed at the right of each entry. The ornament and the handwritten shelf mark "A 1 / 455024" are not transcribed.
